notes.title: 2018 Update!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Happy New Year![/h1]
We are glad to present you the new Cologne 2018! It is a really massive update or even a remake actually. The game is completely new. There are now 3 race modes, 28 tracks, 8 planets, more upgrades, more colors, Head Display customization, racer name customization, Multiplayer or as its called in the game WorldWide Racing Plugin. Please comment below what do you think. Enjoy, and again...
Happy New Year!

ːwallookː Our [url=https://web.facebook.com/wallookcompany/]Facebook[/url][/b]
